reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core finding of P2/P5/P6/P8—that adding Cu@Gr to WCu composites improves thermal conductivity by ~24% through better wetting and a continuous Cu network—as a prediction, and applies it to the same material system and processing route. The addition of irradiation conditions is a minor extension without mechanistic justification or integration with the existing evidence, and the proposed mechanism is taken almost verbatim from the passages.
